journey.observation: With VoiceOver running and its Caption Panel enabled, Safari exposed the page title and visible level-one heading as ‘Trusted government knowledge discovery’. The retained frame shows that heading and the VoiceOver Caption Panel.
journey.limitation: The page title and level-one heading were visible while VoiceOver was active, but a heading-rotor selection was not retained in the nine-frame sequence.

journey.observation: Safari and VoiceOver identified ‘Skip to main content’ as a link. Activating it moved accessibility focus to the main content container before the worked answer.
VoiceOver exposed the separately named claim 1 and claim 3 comparison tickboxes. After both were selected, each reported value 1 and the enabled trigger was exposed as ‘Compare 2 selected claims’.

Activating ‘Show foundations for claim 1’ moved accessibility focus to ‘Selected foundation’. Safari exposed Authority, Assertion, Verification, Freshness, Integrity, Access, Rights and Coverage as separate facets.

Activating ‘Compare 2 selected claims’ moved accessibility focus to the named ‘Evidence comparison’ region. Safari exposed an 11-row comparison through Limitations without presenting a combined trust score.
With the query ‘housing’, all four federated collections selected and the result limit set to 8, the visible status read exactly ‘797 matching records; 8 shown.’
journey.limitation: The Caption Panel showed ‘Filter results, collapsed, summary’ rather than the visible ‘797 matching records; 8 shown.’ status, so the automatic spoken live-status wording was not proved.

journey.observation: Activating ‘View record and provenance’ opened record ‘govuk-discovery:federated:land-registry:57845’, titled ‘Reduced regulation of English social housing providers: registration requirements’, and exposed its HM Land Registry collection and limitations.

Within the opened record, VoiceOver focused the descriptively named ‘Open recorded source link’. The display retained the producer-declared source-link role, destination hostname ‘www.gov.uk’ and ‘Not independently established’ source-authority label. The link was not opened.

Closing the record restored focus to its originating ‘View record and provenance’ button. Closing the evidence comparison restored focus to ‘Compare 2 selected claims’; both selected tickboxes remained selected.

limitations: The page title and level-one heading were visible while VoiceOver was active, but a heading-rotor selection was not retained in the nine-frame sequence.
The Caption Panel showed ‘Filter results, collapsed, summary’ rather than the visible ‘797 matching records; 8 shown.’ status, so the automatic spoken live-status wording was not proved.
VoiceOver speech audio was not captured; the retained sequence uses the Caption Panel and manual Safari observations.
This screenshot sequence is not a continuous recording.
This observation covers one manual environment and does not establish WCAG conformance.
